description: This file defines a Dashlet class for displaying user-specific project tasks in SuiteCRM. It extends a generic dashlet class, loads dashlet configuration data, and customizes the query to exclude completed tasks.

classes.name: MyProjectTaskDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet for displaying user's incomplete project tasks in SuiteCRM, inheriting functionality from DashletGeneric.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dashlet data, sets default title if none provided, and prepares search fields and columns.

methods.name: buildWhere
methods.description: Builds and customizes the WHERE clause for the dashlet's query, excluding tasks with 100% completion.
